items.stem: Explain how a histogram, a frequency polygon and ogives are constructed. How can the median and the mode be located graphically?
items.answer: Histogram: adjacent rectangles on continuous classes (adjust unequal widths); polygon: join mid-points of tops; ogives: less than (upper limits) and more than (lower limits); median at intersection of ogives (or at N/2 on one ogive); mode from the tallest rectangle of the histogram by joining diagonals.
